==Chapter Summary Project==
Special thanks goes out to [[User:GuanYu79]] for suggesting this. The '''Chapter Summary Project''' will take a while. {{tom}} will definitely be out before this is done and {{amol}} might be out as well. 

The goal here is to create decent chapter summaries for every chapter, prologue and epilogue. That is 578 summaries so far. As it stands now, some are really good, some are okay, some need work and some are just placeholders. 
Here is a breakdown of the steps:
*<s>'''Step 1:''' In the coming days, I will be going through each chapter summary and determining the status of it.</s>
*'''Step 2:''' Start in on improvements.

Seems pretty simple. I'm not going to try and lay down any kind of hard-and-fast rules as to what is "acceptable." If I think it is good, I'll mark it as such. If you don't think it is good and could use some improvement, either go ahead and improve it, or let me know on the [[User talk:Mainphramephreak/Project|talk page]]. I think we can be collaborative about this to make the wiki better.

The following tables will contain the status of each chapter. If you improve a chapter, go ahead and edit this page, find the chapter listing and update the status. Each chapter's status will go on the line under the template for that chapter. If you are unsure about editing these tables (they can be kind of tricky), please let me know on the talk page, and I'll take care of it. 

Please let me know if there you have any questions. Happy editing!!!

'''''UPDATE''''': Most of the chapter summaries require some work in the "Notes" section. I think that what is at the [[Wotwiki:Chapter summaries]] page looks good. I will be updating all of the chapter summaries to conform to that page. Any suggestions would be appriciated.

===Alphabetizing Project===
====Alphabetizing Done, but kept here for future reference====
In an effort to keep my sanity (which is a difficult thing these days), this is a list of categories for the Alphabetizing Project. People who have two (or more) names are going to be listed under their last name. I am doing this by category instead of page by page. If you wish to help out, here are some guidelines that I have been using. If you believe that something needs to be changed, please let me know [[User talk:Mainphramephreak/Project|here]].
*To start, edit the whole page and go to the bottom of the edit window. 
*Type in <nowiki>{{DEFAULTSORT:Last Name, First Name}}</nowiki>
**The Sea Folk will be alphabetized by the name that comes ''after'' "din", not their "salt name" (e.g. Zaida din Parede Blackwing would be categorized as "Parede Blackwing, Zaida din").
**Illianers will who have three names will be alphabetized by the name that comes ''before'' "den" (e.g. Mattin Stepaneos den Balgar would be categorized as "Stepaneos den Balgar, Mattin).
**Married Saldaean women will be alphabetized under their husband's last name, without the prefix (e.g. Deira ni'Ghaline t'Bashere would be categorized as "Bashere, Deira ni'Ghaline).
*Pages that are in the category but are not people will need to be edited differently (See [[:Category:Asha'man]] for an example)
**To do this, if you have Java, edit the whole page and change the "Category Options" and put a space in the second block. If you don't have Java, the old-school way is to put a pipe ("|") and then a space after the category name. UPDATE: Okay, after some research and trial and error, there is a change. Please put the article name after the space (using either Java or old-school method). This will allow those particular pages to be alphabetized at the top of the category. See [[:Category:Ever Victorious Army]] and the four pages at the top (before "A") for examples. Any questions, please post them on the talk page.
**Only do this for the current category in question (i.e. "Silver sword pin" needs to have the space only for the Asha'man category and not for the Symbols category)
*For those people whose last name starts with a small letter (i.e. al'Thor, al'Vere, ect), you need to capitalize the name for it to sort under the A's. If you don't, a new section of the list will be started with the small letter. I also usually leave a hidden note (<nowiki>start with "<!--" and end with "--></nowiki>) to let other editors know not to change that. To see an example, edit Rand's or Elaida's page and go to the bottom of the edit window.
*Once a category is done, feel free to edit this page and strike out the category you have done (using <nowiki><s> and </s></nowiki>). For this and this alone do I give perssion for other editors to edit this user sub-page.
*Obviously, when some of the smaller categories are done, it will make the bigger categories easier. Also, when you edit one person, they are updated for all of the categories to which they belong.
*The numbers after the categories are current as of 17 November, 2009. Remove number when a category is done. These numbers include those people who only have one name as well as those items that need to be put at the top (see Category Option space issue above).

Hopefully all of that made sense. Here are the categories in no particular order:

====Alphabetizing Checks====
Now that the alphabetizing is done, I will be going through and checking to make sure things were done. Another project concerning the Categories will be forthcoming.
